message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to query VirusTotal’s servers directly. However, here’s what you can do yourself:

1. **Visit** https://www.virustotal.com/gui/domain/amazon.com  
2. If prompted, log in with your account credentials.  
3. You’ll see the full domain report—scan results, reputation score, associated IPs, etc.  

If you prefer programmatic access, you can use the VirusTotal public API v3. Here’s a quick example in Python:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "amazon_key123"
DOMAIN   = "amazon.com"

headers = {"x-apikey": API_KEY}
url     = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}"

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure to keep your API key secure and never share it publicly. Let me know if you need help setting up this script!
